exact: positive regulation of DNA-dependent transcription, elongation
positive regulation of transcription elongation, DNA-dependent

definition: Any process that activates or increases the frequency, rate or extent of transcription elongation, the extension of an RNA molecule after transcription initiation and promoter clearance by the addition of ribonucleotides catalyzed by a DNA-dependent RNA polymerase.
label: positive regulation of DNA-templated transcription, elongation
